title: Safeguarding Decentralized Social Media: LLM Agents for Automating Community Rule Compliance

bias_targets.methodology: Correlation analysis to determine if the length and verbosity of community rule definitions influence the strictness of the compliance scores assigned by the LLM moderators.
Correlation analysis evaluating whether a post's engagement level (an aggregated metric of replies, reblogs, and favorites) relates to its assigned compliance score.
Correlation analysis measuring the impact of admitted sensitive content (e.g., the presence of content warnings and spoiler text) on the assigned moderation scores.

Correlation analysis to check if there is a relationship between the severity of the compliance score assigned to a post and the character length of the justification or improvement suggestions provided.

Analyzing the LLM's average compliance checking outcomes against specific community themes to evaluate if the overarching topic of a server (e.g., NSFW-centric communities) biases the assigned scores.
